description_expanded: ABOUT SUNSEEKERS 3: Welcome to Sunseekers 3! Relax and unwind in this newly remodeled 2 bedroom condo that overlooks the beautiful emerald coast. Sleeping up to 6 guests comfortably, this condo is directly on the Gulf with only a lawn between you & the white sand. With gorgeous views surrounding you will never want to leave! Step outside and relax on the patio or the surrounding neatly manicured lawn that is a perfect setting for a night of stargazing. This backyard oasis will have you lounging for hours and enjoying the sounds of the ocean breeze. When you need a break from the beach, Sunseekers is less than 5 minutes from the great shops and restaurants on 30A. Bring your family and friends and enjoy a well-deserved getaway at Sunseekers 3 in Blue Mountain Beach! ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain Beach, Florida, is a perfect destination for those looking to enjoy a mix of relaxation and outdoor activities. The pristine beaches are the main attraction, offering soft, sugar-white sand and clear, calm waters that are ideal for children. Families can spend their days building sandcastles, swimming, and playing beach games, all while enjoying the stunning coastal views. Beyond the beach, Blue Mountain Beach is near several rare coastal dune lakes, such as Draper Lake and Big Redfish Lake. These unique ecosystems are perfect for kayaking or paddleboarding, allowing visitors to explore the area while spotting local wildlife. For those who prefer to stay on land, the Timpoochee Trail offers a scenic bike path that runs along 30A. It's an easy and enjoyable ride, with opportunities to stop at parks, shops, and cafes along the way. After a day of adventure, beach goers can treat themselves to a visit to Blue Mountain Creamery, a popular local ice cream shop known for its homemade ice creams and sorbets. It's a sweet way to cool off and enjoy some quality time together. For those who enjoy hiking and nature walks, nearby state parks like Grayton Beach State Park and Point Washington State Forest offer trails that immerse visitors in the lush coastal landscapes, providing a chance to reconnect with nature. Water sports are another exciting option in Blue Mountain Beach. You can rent paddle boards, kayaks, or even try surfing or snorkeling in the warm Gulf waters. If you prefer a more relaxed activity, consider a picnic at one of the local parks. Grayton Beach State Park, with its beautiful picnic areas overlooking the dunes and lakes, offers a peaceful setting for a meal surrounded by nature. BEACH ACCESS: * Blue Mountain Private Community Beach Access PARKING: * Free Parking for 1 Vehicle PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * No smoking permitted * No pets allowed ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. **Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on at all times. At any given point, adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction without notification. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
